_source.description: Rare earth element mining and deposit sites
_source.origin: USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (Rare Earths chapter), USGS Mineral Resources Data System (MRDS), and company disclosures (MP Materials, Lynas, etc.).
_source.notes: Major REE deposits. Coordinates from USGS MRDS and company filings.

heavy_rare_earth.name: Kvanefjeld
heavy_rare_earth.notes: REE + uranium + zinc, one of world's largest deposits

heavy_rare_earth.name: Norra Kärr
heavy_rare_earth.notes: Heavy REE — dysprosium, yttrium; one of few outside China

heavy_rare_earth.name: Tomtor
heavy_rare_earth.notes: Niobium + REE, Yakutia; extremely high grades

heavy_rare_earth.name: Lovozero
heavy_rare_earth.notes: Loparite ore — lanthanum, cerium, neodymium; Kola Peninsula

heavy_rare_earth.name: Nechalacho
heavy_rare_earth.notes: Canada's first rare earth producer, NWT; bastnäsite ore

heavy_rare_earth.name: Round Top Mountain
heavy_rare_earth.notes: Heavy REE rhyolite deposit, Texas; critical minerals

light_rare_earth.name: Mountain Pass
light_rare_earth.notes: Only active US rare earth mine; cerium, lanthanum, neodymium

light_rare_earth.name: Bear Lodge
light_rare_earth.notes: REE deposit in Wyoming Black Hills; NdPr focus

light_rare_earth.name: Wicheeda
light_rare_earth.notes: Light REE carbonatite deposit, British Columbia

light_rare_earth.name: Fen Complex
light_rare_earth.notes: Carbonatite REE, Telemark; European supply potential

strategic_minerals.name: Kiruna Mine
strategic_minerals.notes: Europe's largest REE discovery (2023) — 1M+ tonnes REE oxides

strategic_minerals.name: Phalaborwa
strategic_minerals.notes: Phosphate + REE by-product, major strategic source

strategic_minerals.name: Bayan Obo
strategic_minerals.notes: World's largest REE mine; ~60% global supply

strategic_minerals.name: Mount Weld
strategic_minerals.notes: Highest-grade REE deposit globally; NdPr production

strategic_minerals.name: Steenkampskraal
strategic_minerals.notes: Monazite thorium + REE; historic mine restart
